import glob, re
tot=0
for f in glob.glob('app/*.py')+glob.glob('app/rotas/*.py'):
    ls=open(f,encoding='utf-8').read().split('\n')
    n=0
    for i in range(len(ls)-1):
        if re.match(r'^\s+.*"""$', ls[i]) and ls[i+1].strip()=='':
            n+=1
    tot+=n
    print(f,n)
print('total',tot)
EOF
